svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-07-30
svg.desc: FireBolt validation and Phase 3 ability migration.
svg.text: 2026-07-30 - FireBolt validation and Phase 3 migration
main | 7 commits: 5186ea8, a47c56e, 6b93792, 04eba36, e998c3b, de69a23, 3791f0b
Daily job
Make migrated abilities load and execute repeatably, then move more player abilities into XML.
FireBolt, registry/cost safety, FireBlast, ArcaneShards, Electrocute, smoke scripts, and PIE cleanup changed.
BEFORE
Migration without a full gate
FireBolt definition and attributes needed fixes.
Ability registry and cost checks were fragile.
Phase 3 abilities were not all graph-backed.
PIE/editor lifetime could retain stale objects.
AFTER
Repeatable XML migration gate
FireBolt definition/attributes, graph smoke support, and build/run scripts are aligned.
Ability-definition registry exists; cost checks are client-safe and application authoritative.
FireBlast, ArcaneShards, and Electrocute move to XML with new nodes.
Weak captures and cache clearing reduce PIE leaks; cooldown scaling is marked fixed.
Guard: migrated ability = XML definition + registered native nodes + smoke path.
Important guard
A definition that loads is not enough.
Registration, execution, cost authority, and
lifetime cleanup must all be covered.
Validation / newcomer path
Use build/test helpers and graph smoke support.
Trace FireBolt first, then Phase 3 XML abilities
and their registered native nodes.
